2.8 "**Business Day**" means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in Rivers State, Nigeria;

Policy on Approval Authority for Contract Amendments
Document type/version: Policy document

3.1 **Amendment** – A formal, written change to the terms of an existing contract, including changes to scope, deliverables, timelines, pricing, or any other material provision.

3.2 **Material Amendment** – Any amendment that:
- Increases or decreases the contract value by more than ₦2,500,000 or 10% of the original contract value, whichever is greater;
- Extends the contract duration beyond the original term;
- Changes the core deliverables or performance indicators;
- Alters the risk allocation, indemnity, or liability provisions.

3.3 **Non-Material Amendment** – Any amendment that does not meet the threshold for a material amendment, such as correction of typographical errors, updates to contact details, or minor administrative adjustments.

3.4 **RSMoH** – Rivers State Ministry of Health, the parent ministry with oversight authority over RSHOI.

3.5 **Program Director** – The head of RSHOI, responsible for overall program delivery and accountability.

**4. APPROVAL AUTHORITY**

4.1 **General Principle**

No contract amendment shall be executed without prior written approval from the designated approving authority. Verbal approvals, including those given via telephone or in person, are not valid and shall not be relied upon.

4.2 **Approval Levels for Contract Amendments**

| Amendment Category | Approving Authority | Additional Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Material Amendments (value ≤ ₦2,500,000 and no change to duration or core deliverables) | Program Manager or Head of Unit | None |
| Material Amendments – value above ₦2,500,000 but not exceeding ₦10,000,000 | Program Director | None |
| Material Amendments – value above ₦10,000,000, or any amendment extending contract duration beyond 12 months | Program Director | Countersignature of the Commissioner for Health (RSMoH) |
| Any amendment that changes the scope or deliverables as defined in the original Terms of Reference | Program Director | Countersignature of the Commissioner for Health (RSMoH) |

4.3 **Current Authorisation**

4.4 **Delegation of Authority**

4.4.1 The Program Director may delegate the authority to approve non-material amendments to the Deputy Program Director or the Head of Operations, provided the delegation is documented in writing and filed with the Office of the Program Director.

4.4.2 The Program Director may not delegate authority for material amendments, except in cases of extended absence (more than 14 consecutive days), in which case the Deputy Program Director may act, subject to the countersignature requirement in Section 4.2 above.

4.4.3 Any delegated authority shall be exercised in accordance with the provisions of this policy, and the delegating officer shall retain oversight responsibility.

**5. SIGNATURE REQUIREMENTS**

5.1 **Execution of Amendments**

5.1.1 All amendments must be signed by the authorised signatory(ies) in accordance with Section 4.2.

5.1.2 The signature block on the amendment document shall include:
- The name and title of the signatory
- The date of signing
- The RSHOI official seal (where applicable)

5.1.3 For amendments requiring RSMoH countersignature, the amendment shall not be effective until both signatures are affixed. The RSHOI signatory shall sign first, followed by the RSMoH countersignatory.

5.2 **Witness Requirements**

5.2.1 Amendments with a value exceeding ₦10,000,000 shall be witnessed by a staff member of the RSHOI Finance Unit or the Legal Officer, who shall sign the amendment document as a witness.

**6. DOCUMENTATION AND RECORDS MANAGEMENT**

6.1 **Amendment File**

6.1.1 Each amendment shall be assigned a unique amendment reference number by the Office of the Program Director upon initiation. The reference number shall follow the format RSHOI-AMND-YYYY-XXX, where YYYY is the calendar year and XXX is the sequential number.

6.1.2 The amendment file shall contain, at minimum:
- The original contract and all prior amendments
- The draft amendment document showing tracked changes
- The completed Amendment Request Form (Form RSHOI-ARF-01)
- Written justification for the amendment, including any change in budget or scope
- Evidence of budget availability, where applicable
- The executed amendment document with all required signatures
- Any correspondence relating to the negotiation of the amendment

6.1.3 The amendment file shall be maintained by the Contracts Unit and shall be available for inspection by internal audit, the RSMoH, and other authorised parties upon request.

6.2 **Amendment Register**

6.2.1 The Contracts Unit shall maintain a central Amendment Register. The register shall record, for each amendment:
- The amendment reference number
- The contract title and reference number
- The date of initiation
- The date of execution
- The value of the amendment, if any
- The approval authority exercised
- The effective date of the amendment

6.2.2 The Amendment Register shall be reviewed monthly by the Head of Operations and quarterly by the Program Director.

6.3 **Filing and Retention**

6.3.1 Executed amendments shall be filed with the original contract. A copy shall be provided to the RSMoH where countersignature was required.

6.3.2 Amendment records shall be retained for a period of seven years following the conclusion or termination of the contract, after which they may be archived or destroyed in accordance with the RSHOI Records Management Policy.

6.4 **Reporting**

6.4.1 A summary of all amendments approved during each quarter shall be included in the quarterly report to the RSHOI Board of Trustees.

6.4.2 For amendments exceeding ₦5,000,000 in value, the Program Director shall provide a brief narrative to the Board of Trustees explaining the reason for the amendment and the expected impact on project delivery.

**7. REVIEW AND COMPLIANCE**

7.1 **Compliance Monitoring**

7.1.1 The Legal Officer shall conduct a quarterly review of a sample of amendment files to verify compliance with this policy. The sample shall include at least one amendment from each approval category defined in Section 4.2.

7.1.2 The review shall check, among other things:
- That the correct approval authority was exercised
- That all required signatures are present and dated
- That the amendment register is accurate and up to date
- That the amendment file contains all required documentation

7.1.3 Findings from the quarterly review shall be reported to the Program Director. Any instances of non-compliance shall be documented and corrective action shall be taken.

7.2 **Internal Audit**

7.2.1 Internal audit shall review compliance with this policy as part of its regular audit cycle. The audit may also be triggered by specific concerns raised by the Program Director, the Finance Unit, or the RSMoH.

7.2.2 The Contracts Unit shall cooperate fully with internal audit and shall provide access to all amendment files and the Amendment Register upon request.

7.3 **Breach of Policy**

7.3.1 Any staff member who approves or executes an amendment without the required authority, or who otherwise breaches this policy, may be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with the RSHOI Human Resources Policy.

C. Owing to the expansion of the outreach calendar to include additional routine immunization campaigns and the introduction of a maternal health screening component in the second quarter of 2024, the Parties have mutually agreed to revise the scope and value of the Original Agreement;

D. The Parties wish to record the said revisions in a formal written amendment, which shall supersede and replace any conflicting terms of the Original Agreement, whether express or implied.

a) Rapid diagnostic test kits for malaria, typhoid, and hepatitis B, in quantities sufficient for the outreach schedule from August to December 2024;

documents.title: Policy on Approval Authority for Contract Amendments
documents.content:
3.1 **Amendment** – A formal, written change to the terms of an existing contract, including changes to scope, deliverables, timelines, pricing, or any other material provision.

3.2 **Material Amendment** – Any amendment that:
- Increases or decreases the contract value by more than ₦2,500,000 or 10% of the original contract value, whichever is greater;
- Extends the contract duration beyond the original term;
- Changes the core deliverables or performance indicators;
- Alters the risk allocation, indemnity, or liability provisions.

3.3 **Non-Material Amendment** – Any amendment that does not meet the threshold for a material amendment, such as correction of typographical errors, updates to contact details, or minor administrative adjustments.

3.4 **RSMoH** – Rivers State Ministry of Health, the parent ministry with oversight authority over RSHOI.

3.5 **Program Director** – The head of RSHOI, responsible for overall program delivery and accountability.

**4. APPROVAL AUTHORITY**

4.1 **General Principle**

No contract amendment shall be executed without prior written approval from the designated approving authority. Verbal approvals, including those given via telephone or in person, are not valid and shall not be relied upon.

4.2 **Approval Levels for Contract Amendments**

| Amendment Category | Approving Authority | Additional Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Material Amendments (value ≤ ₦2,500,000 and no change to duration or core deliverables) | Program Manager or Head of Unit | None |
| Material Amendments – value above ₦2,500,000 but not exceeding ₦10,000,000 | Program Director | None |
| Material Amendments – value above ₦10,000,000, or any amendment extending contract duration beyond 12 months | Program Director | Countersignature of the Commissioner for Health (RSMoH) |
| Any amendment that changes the scope or deliverables as defined in the original Terms of Reference | Program Director | Countersignature of the Commissioner for Health (RSMoH) |

4.3 **Current Authorisation**

4.4 **Delegation of Authority**

4.4.1 The Program Director may delegate the authority to approve non-material amendments to the Deputy Program Director or the Head of Operations, provided the delegation is documented in writing and filed with the Office of the Program Director.

4.4.2 The Program Director may not delegate authority for material amendments, except in cases of extended absence (more than 14 consecutive days), in which case the Deputy Program Director may act, subject to the countersignature requirement in Section 4.2 above.

4.4.3 Any delegated authority shall be exercised in accordance with the provisions of this policy, and the delegating officer shall retain oversight responsibility.

**5. SIGNATURE REQUIREMENTS**

5.1 **Execution of Amendments**

5.1.1 All amendments must be signed by the authorised signatory(ies) in accordance with Section 4.2.

5.1.2 The signature block on the amendment document shall include:
- The name and title of the signatory
- The date of signing
- The RSHOI official seal (where applicable)

5.1.3 For amendments requiring RSMoH countersignature, the amendment shall not be effective until both signatures are affixed. The RSHOI signatory shall sign first, followed by the RSMoH countersignatory.

5.2 **Witness Requirements**

5.2.1 Amendments with a value exceeding ₦10,000,000 shall be witnessed by a staff member of the RSHOI Finance Unit or the Legal Officer, who shall sign the amendment document as a witness.

**Policy on Approval Authority for Contract Amendments**

**6. DOCUMENTATION AND RECORDS MANAGEMENT**

6.1 **Amendment File**

6.1.1 Each amendment shall be assigned a unique amendment reference number by the Office of the Program Director upon initiation. The reference number shall follow the format RSHOI-AMND-YYYY-XXX, where YYYY is the calendar year and XXX is the sequential number.

6.1.2 The amendment file shall contain, at minimum:
- The original contract and all prior amendments
- The draft amendment document showing tracked changes
- The completed Amendment Request Form (Form RSHOI-ARF-01)
- Written justification for the amendment, including any change in budget or scope
- Evidence of budget availability, where applicable
- The executed amendment document with all required signatures
- Any correspondence relating to the negotiation of the amendment

6.1.3 The amendment file shall be maintained by the Contracts Unit and shall be available for inspection by internal audit, the RSMoH, and other authorised parties upon request.

6.2 **Amendment Register**

6.2.1 The Contracts Unit shall maintain a central Amendment Register. The register shall record, for each amendment:
- The amendment reference number
- The contract title and reference number
- The date of initiation
- The date of execution
- The value of the amendment, if any
- The approval authority exercised
- The effective date of the amendment

6.2.2 The Amendment Register shall be reviewed monthly by the Head of Operations and quarterly by the Program Director.

6.3 **Filing and Retention**

6.3.1 Executed amendments shall be filed with the original contract. A copy shall be provided to the RSMoH where countersignature was required.

6.3.2 Amendment records shall be retained for a period of seven years following the conclusion or termination of the contract, after which they may be archived or destroyed in accordance with the RSHOI Records Management Policy.

6.4 **Reporting**

6.4.1 A summary of all amendments approved during each quarter shall be included in the quarterly report to the RSHOI Board of Trustees.

6.4.2 For amendments exceeding ₦5,000,000 in value, the Program Director shall provide a brief narrative to the Board of Trustees explaining the reason for the amendment and the expected impact on project delivery.

**7. REVIEW AND COMPLIANCE**

7.1 **Compliance Monitoring**

7.1.1 The Legal Officer shall conduct a quarterly review of a sample of amendment files to verify compliance with this policy. The sample shall include at least one amendment from each approval category defined in Section 4.2.

7.1.2 The review shall check, among other things:
- That the correct approval authority was exercised
- That all required signatures are present and dated
- That the amendment register is accurate and up to date
- That the amendment file contains all required documentation

7.1.3 Findings from the quarterly review shall be reported to the Program Director. Any instances of non-compliance shall be documented and corrective action shall be taken.

7.2 **Internal Audit**

7.2.1 Internal audit shall review compliance with this policy as part of its regular audit cycle. The audit may also be triggered by specific concerns raised by the Program Director, the Finance Unit, or the RSMoH.

7.2.2 The Contracts Unit shall cooperate fully with internal audit and shall provide access to all amendment files and the Amendment Register upon request.

7.3 **Breach of Policy**

7.3.1 Any staff member who approves or executes an amendment without the required authority, or who otherwise breaches this policy, may be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with the RSHOI Human Resources Policy.
